acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Thinking indicator shows during `status` SSE events
Status message displayed (e.g., "Annie is searching the web...")
Tool calls mapped to user-friendly display names
Tool call card shows tool name and expandable parameters
Tool result indicated with success/failure state
Animated spinner/dots while tool is running
Tool cards appear inline in conversation flow
Multiple sequential tool calls displayed properly
Error state for failed tool calls

doc.title: Epic 20: Annie Web UI
doc.snippet: Display Annie's thinking state and tool calls from existing SSE stream. Backend already streams tool_call and tool_result events via SSE - this story is purely UI rendering.

doc.title: Epic 20 Technical Context

doc.snippet: Defines tool display names mapping and SSE event types (status, token, tool_call, tool_result, done, error) with their corresponding UI handlers.

artifact.reason: Backend SSE event format and emission patterns. Status frames use {"type":"status","message":"..."} format. Tool calls emit via tool orchestration loop.

Tool registration pattern used by backend. Shows tool_info structure with name, description, inputSchema, handler.
